exposure: Maternal plasma PlGF levels (low vs. normal)
Maternal plasma placental growth factor (PlGF) levels
cohort: 696 pregnant women with suspected preeclampsia in urban Mozambique
finding: Low maternal plasma PlGF concentrations were associated with a shorter clinic-to-delivery interval and increased risks of adverse pregnancy outcomes, including preeclampsia, preterm birth, and lower birth weight, in women with suspected preeclampsia.
mod_finding: Low PlGF was associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was more common in the low PlGF group
